checklist.title: Checklist for Yacht Registration
checklist.about: details all forms and documents that must be provided for a yacht to be provisionally or permanently registered.

inspection.commercial: The BMSR require commercial yachts to undergo a Flag State Inspection by one of our Appointed Nautical Inspectors a minimum of once every five years.
inspection.private: Private yachts are recommended to undergo inspection but there is no specific requirement to do so.
